releaseNotes.headline: The rail shows every tool
releaseNotes.summary: Version 0.2.11 lets the floating rail grow to show all of your AI tools at once instead of scrolling.

highlights.title: No more scrolling rail
highlights.detail: The rail sizes itself to every visible row, up to your display’s height at the current scale, so Codex, Claude, Cursor, and Grok Build all stay in view.

highlights.title: Sign in to Claude in place
highlights.detail: Sign In on the Claude row in Manage AI Tools runs Claude Code’s own login and takes the code you paste back.

highlights.title: Every local tool at a glance
highlights.detail: Manage AI Tools lists ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and Grok Build on one page with their state, a rail switch, and their limits behind a disclosure.
